crossRefs.note: Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.
He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.
“The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers…
“Whoever receives one such little child in my name, receives me, and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him…
and said to them, “Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent…
Whoever listens to you listens to me, and whoever rejects you rejects me. Whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.”
That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God…
As therefore you received Christ Jesus, the Lord, walk in him,
Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.

translations.web: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”
translations.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever receives the one I send receives Me, and whoever receives Me receives the One who sent Me.”
translations.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
translations.asv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, he that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
